column1: # Word-index keys FileMaker Server 26.0.3's engine wrote for 140 values in 56 index languages (tools/fms-script-harness/wordbreaks, query-program.md 7.2): each of . , : / - ' ’ · _ ; and a no-break space between two digits (1c2, 12c30, 1c234, 1c2c3), two letters (abccd, lceau), a digit and a letter (1cb, ac1) and at either end (c1, 1c, ca, ac), and 8 dates, times and numbers as locales write them.
# value escapes: \r \n \t \\, \u{hex} for invisible code points; keys in hex, several sorted and space-separated.
# Rows: every value in English (21); another language only where its keys differ from English's, System (1) only where they differ from Unicode standard's (3). Languages probed: 1-4, 16-65, 67, 76.
